verdict.rationale: Data residency is a fair question for a KYC/compliance SaaS that handles identity data, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents choosing a storage region or data residency. The mentions of 200+ country coverage and per-geography scoring thresholds concern verification scope and decisioning, not where data is stored, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
